operational_and_scientific_limitations: Exploratory evidence is EXPLORATORY_PROSPECTIVE_ONLY and cannot auto-qualify.
Historical effective yield estimates (M1=1.415/hr, M5=0.581/hr, M15=0.487/hr) are planning estimates only; actual prospective rates are unknown.
Small operational pilots carry zero statistical significance.
Candle direction does not equal verified broker trade settlement or payout.
Live IQ Option WebSocket protocol cannot prove active practice wallet selection; observed wallet status is recorded honestly without practice verification bypass.
provenance_requirements: Closed native EURUSD regular-market candles only (no OTC, no resampling).
Server-time freshness and timestamp alignment validated on every fetch/stream.
Pre-maturity prediction commitment and SHA-256 digest persisted before maturity.
Append-only session ledger with independent verify_session_integrity() check.
WALLET_INDEPENDENT_SPOT_READ_ONLY outbound wire allowlist enforced (EURUSD M1/M5/M15 market data only; zero order or wallet-mutation frames).
